title: How Do These AI Voices Sound?
author: Arkitech-RG
selftext:
This is a short dialogue interaction using AI-generated voices. It's very Skyrim/Fallout inspired, letting the player side between two characters during the dialogue. Let me know if you have any questions or comments! It's for my open-world single-player RPG. All the audio clips were generated with AI.

  
Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5197820/GRIMLIFE/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5197820/GRIMLIFE/)
